parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation; legal gender recognition without surgery and courts that positively recognised same-sex family status show functioning institutions. Social acceptance has measurably risen (70.4% in 2024), and pride marches were held under heavy state protection. However, GI-specific recourse is thin: hate-crime aggravation excludes gender identity (2020 draft withdrawn), planned administrative liability is unconfirmed, and the documented police non-response to attacks is dated (2011-2013) but never shown remedied for GI cases. Social hostility is documented (taboo status, ex-gay movement, religious disapproval) though friction-tier for a visitor. Male-marker border stops under martial law add a documented document-friction signal, though mobilisation-driven and unclear for foreign visitors. No documented visitor-facing service refusal or facility ban. Worst features are dated incidents and thin GI recourse (tiers 4-5), not universal exposure or organised targeting.
